verdict.rationale: dltHub's deploy walkthrough mentions you can 'Schedule, refresh, backfill, and observe runs' via `dlthub deploy` (dlt-docs-11), and dlt integrates with orchestrators like Airflow (dlt-docs-6) which support cron-style scheduling, but the evidence never details sub-hour granularity, explicit cron expression syntax, or a manual-trigger mechanism within dlt/dltHub itself. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-pipeline schedule configuration (cron syntax), sub-hour interval support, manual trigger API/UI, and independent confirmation of these scheduling controls in practice.
